items.fullText: Lambda Boosts AI Factory Resiliency and Efficiency With NVIDIA Photonics November 16, 2026 by Brian Sparks 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! To train an AI model, thousands of GPUs have to work together, requiring a network that’s fast, efficient and resilient. Lambda is tackling the network piece of the puzzle with NVIDIA Photonics co-packaged optics (CPO) switches. The cloud provider is using the switches to connect NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 racks with more than 10,000 GPUs, delivering lower power, higher resiliency and longer mean time between interruptions (MTBI) to an AI factory at scale. “Networking has to keep pace with the demands of increasingly large AI clusters,” said Dave Ward, president of cloud services at Lambda. “Bringing co-packaged optics into a deployment of this scale is an important step toward building the infrastructure needed to support the next generation of AI.” Read All NVIDIA Announcements From SC26 In the company’s tests using the switches, network latency — the time needed for moving data — dropped by about 4% at rack scale and by up to about 10% at pod scale. Across rack, scalable unit and pod configurations, the network maintains the same throughput as conventional pluggable optics. Delivering Power Efficiency and Resiliency at Scale Improving power efficiency and resiliency matters because the network sits at the center of AI factory productivity. In a large training job, one interrupted link can stall thousands of GPUs. With agentic inference, one network disruption can introduce cascading latency effects on many agents. Every interruption costs time, and every watt spent on networking is a watt not available for compute. NVIDIA Photonics addresses both power efficiency and resiliency. By replacing pluggable transceivers with co-packaged optical engines on the switch package, it delivers up to 5x better power efficiency and up to 15x higher reliability than conventional pluggable optics. items.fullText: NVIDIA Expands Slurm to Bring Quantum Computing Into Supercomputing Quantum hardware developers, software providers and supercomputing centers are adopting the community-built Slurm workloads manager and the NVIDIA quantum platform to integrate quantum processors, design future systems and develop scientific applications. November 16, 2026 by Sam Stanwyck 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Quantum processor deployments at supercomputing centers have grown nearly sevenfold over the past five years, with nearly 30 supercomputing centers around the world now in the process of deploying over 50 quantum processors. Many of these centers use Slurm to run scientific supercomputing workloads, so expanding its support for quantum processors builds on familiar workflows and tools, enabling computational chemists, nuclear physicists and materials scientists to bring quantum computing into their research domains without friction. In a new release, Slurm builds on previous work with IBM, Pasqal and the wider quantum computing community to allow QPU builders to create a single interface to their hardware for every supercomputing center, through a simple file. This makes it easier than ever for HPC centers and QPU builders to integrate and serve their hardware. The expansion is already being adopted by Alice & Bob , IBM , IQM , Pasqal , Quantinuum and MQSC and supports the widely used QRMI and QDMI interfaces. Read All NVIDIA Announcements From SC26 Beating the Bottleneck Until now, integrating a QPU into a supercomputing center meant a new software challenge for every new QPU or supercomputing center. By building on existing quantum-HPC interfaces such as QRMI and QDMI, the Slurm expansion allows QPU builders to reuse their integrations across all their deployments. items.fullText: NVIDIA Sweeps MLPerf Training and Endpoints as Vera Rubin Debuts With Leading Performance November 16, 2026 by Shruti Koparkar 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! In its MLPerf benchmarks debut, with results released today, the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform delivers leading performance across training, post-training and agentic inference. NVIDIA swept every MLPerf Training v6.1 benchmark and, in its first MLPerf Endpoints submission, delivered more than 10x generational gains in throughput per watt for agentic AI — measuring how much agentic work a system delivers with each watt of power. These results are just the beginning. Vera Rubin performance will keep climbing through continuous optimization of NVIDIA’s CUDA-powered software stack , so the infrastructure that customers invest in today delivers more value over time. NVIDIA Sweeps MLPerf Training v6.1 AI agents are now everywhere, writing code, running business workflows, answering customer questions and, as this week’s SC26 conference highlights , advancing scientific research. Faster training means smarter agents can reach users sooner, drug discovery models can keep pace with new lab data and fraud-detection models can adapt to new threats faster. MLPerf Training measures how fast a system can train a range of AI models to a target level of accuracy. The NVIDIA platform was the only one with results on every benchmark this round, spanning large language models, image generation, recommender systems and reinforcement learning post-training. In its debut, Vera Rubin NVL72 delivered up to 2x more performance per GPU than the highly optimized NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 system — early results that show the pace of generation-over-generation innovation. items.fullText: NVIDIA CUDA-X Libraries Give Agents the Tools to Accelerate Scientific Discovery November 16, 2026 by Kibibi Moseley 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! With expanded NVIDIA CUDA-X libraries, including cuPhoton, cuPotential and cuSpa, researchers can sift through vast amounts of data to accelerate research, from astrophysics and materials science to single-cell biology. The speedups are helping scientists analyze larger datasets and model more complex systems. The new libraries give AI agents the tools to help researchers make discoveries faster than ever. Read All NVIDIA Announcements From SC26 Bringing Black Holes Into Focus Seeing a black hole takes a telescope the size of Earth. The Event Horizon Telescope links radio dishes worldwide, generating petabytes of data that can take months to process. With NVIDIA cuPhoton.xBeam, a module within the cuPhoton Toolkit , black hole observations from the Event Horizon Telescope can now be correlated orders of magnitude faster than ever. Analysis that once took over a month now takes eight minutes. By combining global radio dishes into Earth-sized aperture, cuPhoton delivers unprecedented astronomical imaging resolution. cuPhoton successfully correlated observations of powerful black hole jets J1924 and 3C279 in the night sky — making it a reality to reconstruct a Messier 87* black hole galaxy in real time. The entire pipeline, from data loading and processing to visualization, runs on distributed multi-GPU systems or a compact NVIDIA DGX Spark system, helping scientists study how gas spirals inward under a black hole’s powerful gravitational pull. Steering Fusion Simulations Sustaining plasma at millions of degrees is essential to achieving stable, continuous fusion energy. But simulating its behavior is costly: on petascale systems, a single time step can take days, with simulations running for weeks. items.d: This week at SC26, NVIDIA is marking two decades of CUDA by honoring the researchers, developers and engineers who helped make GPU computing a foundation for modern science and AI.  CUDA’s 20th anniversary presents an occasion to reflect across computing eras, from the people who wrote the very first CUDA programs to the AI developers […]
items.fullText: CUDA at 20: How the Platform Transformed Scientific Computing Over two decades, CUDA, the platform that turned GPUs into the engine of modern science, has advanced Nobel Prize-winning research and more. November 16, 2026 by Brett Murray 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! This week at SC26, NVIDIA is marking two decades of CUDA by honoring the researchers, developers and engineers who helped make GPU computing a foundation for modern science and AI. CUDA’s 20th anniversary presents an occasion to reflect across computing eras, from the people who wrote the very first CUDA programs to the AI developers building on their work today. At the platform’s core is this developer community whose experiments, tools and persistence expanded what accelerated computing could do. From SC06 to SC26 NVIDIA announced CUDA in November 2006 and brought it to the scientific community at SC06, giving scientists and developers a familiar, high-level programming model for using GPUs. It fundamentally extended accelerated computing beyond graphics use cases to accelerate demanding applications for science, simulation and more. In the two decades since, developers have used CUDA to advance Nobel Prize-winning AI research , accelerate scientific applications on supercomputers and support visual effects in Oscar-winning films . Today, more than 11 million developers build on CUDA across the computing stack. items.fullText: NVIDIA Announces Rubin HPC — A New GPU to Accelerate Agents for Science, Engineering and Analytics A record leap in CUDA cores with accelerated data movement shorten time to results for science and engineering workloads. November 16, 2026 by Dan Ernst 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Announced today at SC26, NVIDIA Rubin HPC is a new GPU in the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform designed to accelerate simulation and data processing for science, engineering and analytics workflows. As agents help scientists and engineers explore more candidate materials, molecules and designs, they rely on simulations to test those ideas and guide their next steps. Rubin HPC will accelerate those simulations, shortening the path from exploration to scientific discovery and industrial design. The Rubin HPC GPU features a record number of CUDA cores — more than 50,000 on a single GPU — as well as a sparse data acceleration capability that keeps those cores fed with data, and accelerates GPU-to-GPU connectivity with seventh-generation NVIDIA NVLink interconnect technology. Read All NVIDIA Announcements From SC26 Scientists and engineers rely on simulation to understand complex systems before committing to experiments or physical prototypes. Working with agents, these teams can explore more candidate materials, molecules and designs. This increases demand for the GPU-accelerated simulations needed to evaluate those ideas and guide next steps. “For agents tackling science and engineering, faster simulation means faster discovery,” said Ian Buck , vice president of hyperscale and high-performance computing at NVIDIA. “Rubin HPC accelerates the simulations agents use to test ideas and guide their next steps, helping scientists and engineers explore more possibilities and bring breakthroughs closer.” Turning Faster Computation Into Faster Discovery Across climate models, engineering simulations, genomic analysis and financial risk, scientific computing w

items.fullText: Trump administration Trump says he ‘would not mind’ if Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia CEO The president said he did not know if Alice Huang, the suspected Chinese intelligence asset with whom Jensen Huang had a relationship, was actually a spy. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Trump 'would not mind' having Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO 01:02 Get more news Live on Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 16, 2026, 9:50 AM EST / Updated Nov. 16, 2026, 9:58 AM EST By Megan Brand and Rob Wile President Donald Trump told reporters Monday that he “would not mind” if Jensen Huang were reinstated as CEO of Nvidia after he was ousted following allegations of multiple extramarital relationships, including one with a woman determined to be a Chinese intelligence asset. “I would not mind that,” the president said when asked about a reinstatement, adding that he thinks the ex-Nvidia chief, who resigned last week after the allegations were reported, had “learned a big lesson.” After Huang stepped down, Trump said he would support former Apple CEO Tim Cook as Huang’s successor at Nvidia, which he noted again in comments to White House reporters Monday. The president also told reporters that he did not know if Alice Huang was actually a spy, despite a U.S. intelligence assessment that she was working for Beijing. “I don’t know that she is a spy,” Trump said as he prepared to leave for his Asia trip. Huang’s departure from Nvidia marked a major shakeup that sent ripples through the stock market and raised questions about technology sector vulnerabilities to Chinese espionage operations, which could have national security implications. Nvidia has hired an outside law firm to investigate the allegations against Huang, whose relationships may have violated company policies and who presided over export arrangements that raised concerns about Nvidia chips reaching China. 기술주 투자심리를 흔들고 있지만, 국내 개인투자자들은 주가 하락을 매수 기회로 판단하고 있다. 창업자 젠슨 황의 전격 사임과 후계 구도 불확실성으로 주가가 고점 대비 30% 넘게 하락한 가운데 서학개미들은 일주일 동안 엔비디아 주식 약 4500억원어치를 순매수했다. 나스닥과 반도체 시장의 반등에 베팅하는 3배 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF)에도 대규모 자금이 유입됐다. 16일 한국예탁결제원 증권정보포털(SEIBro)에 따르면 지난 6일부터 13일까지 국내 투자자의 해외주식 순매수 1위는 엔비디아였다. 순매수 결제액은 3억3434만달러(약 4473억원)에 달했다. 같은 기간 나스닥100지수의 일일 수익률을 3배 추종하는 프로셰어즈 울트라프로 QQQ(TQQQ)가 2억7465만달러로 2위, 미국 반도체지수의 일일 수익률을 3배 추종하는 디렉시온 데일리 세미컨덕터 불 3X(SOXL)가 2억3490만달러로 3위를 기록했다. 엔비디아의 경영 리스크가 확대되는 상황에서도 국내 투자자들은 인공지능(AI)과 반도체 산업의 장기 성장성에 무게를 둔 것으로 풀이된다. 특히 개별 종목뿐 아니라 고배율 레버리지 상품까지 매수세가 집중됐다는 점에서 기술주 반등에 대한 공격적인 기대가 드러난다. 엔비디아의 투자 불확실성은 젠슨 황의 갑작스러운 사임에서 비롯됐다. 황 전 CEO는 지난 12일(현지시간) 사장과 최고경영자(CEO), 이사회 이사직에서 물러났다. 이사회는 최고재무책임자(CFO) 콜레트 크레스를 임시 CEO로 선임하고 정식 후임자 선정 절차에 착수했다. 사임을 둘러싼 각종 의혹과 독립 조사도 투자자들의 경계심을 키우고 있다. 중국 정보기관과 연계됐다는 의혹을 받는 인물과의 관계, 추가적인 사내 불륜 의혹 등이 보도됐으며 이사회는 관련 사안에 대한 독립 조사에 들어갔다. 다만 회사는 사임의 공식적인 이유를 명확하게 밝히지 않은 것으로 전해졌다. 주가도 급격하게 조정받았다. 엔비디아는 지난 13일 162.85달러로 거래를 마쳤다. 지난 10월 6일 기록한 장중 최고가 243.37달러와 비교하면 약 33% 낮은 수준이다. 이달 5일 종가 181.60달러와 비교해도 일주일 사이 10% 넘게 하락했다. 지난 12일에는 시간외 거래에서 낙폭이 한때 13%를 웃돌았다. 시장은 이번 사태를 단순한 CEO 교체 이상의 문제로 보고 있다. 엔비디아는 AI 가속기 시장의 기술 경쟁력뿐 아니라 소프트웨어 생태계와 네트워킹, 대규모 고객 관계를 결합한 통합 플랫폼 기업으로 성장했다. 이 과정에서 황 전 CEO의 전략적 판단과 리더십이 기업가치의 중요한 부분을 차지해 왔기 때문이다. 김두언 하나증권 연구원은 임시 CEO가 선임됐지만 정식 후계자는 아직 정해지지 않았고, 독립 조사와 미국 의회의 검증 요구도 별도로 진행되고 있어 불확실성이 장기화할 수 있다고 분석했다. 문준호 삼성증권 연구원도 엔비디아의 비전이 황 전 CEO 개인에게 상당 부분 의존해 왔다는 점에서 현 단계에서는 적정 기업가치를 평가하기 어렵다며 보수적인 접근이 필요하다고 진단했다. 미국 개인투자자들 사이에서도 고위험 파생상품 거래가 늘고 있다. 블룸버그에 따르면 예측시장 플랫폼 칼시(Kalshi)가 지난 5일 출시한 주가 연동 무기한 선물에 개인투자자와 헤지펀드 자금이 유입되고 있다. 엔비디아 무기한 선물의 12일 기준 24시간 거래대금은 1억달러를 넘어섰다. 마이크론 역시 거래대금이 1억달러를 돌파했으며 스페이스X 관련 상품도 하루 8800만달러 규모로 거래됐다. 이 상품은 실제 주식을 보유하지 않고 기초자산의 주가 변동에 베팅하는 구조다. 만기 없이 24시간 거래할 수 있으며 엔비디아 상품에는 최대 4.6배의 레버리지가 items.fullText: AI Day Seoul Brings Together Korea’s Industry Leaders, Startups and Developer Communities November 15, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Over two days at COEX, more than 2,000 attendees converged for AI Day Seoul, bringing together Korea’s industry leaders, startups and developer communities advancing physical AI and AI agents. At the plenary sessions, Deepu Talla, vice president of robotics and edge AI at NVIDIA, said Korea is “punching above its weight,” with Doosan Robotics, Hyundai Motor Group, LG Electronics and SK Group — as well as startups like Real World and Luda Robotics — using NVIDIA platforms to bring general-purpose robotics into the real world. Jonathan Cohen, vice president of applied research at NVIDIA, showed how enterprises can build agents they own and control. Breakout sessions featured speakers from Coupang Intelligent Cloud, Doosan Robotics, LG AI Research, LG Electronics, NAVER Cloud, SK Telecom and Upstage. “It was a genuinely enjoyable time to have candid conversations,” said Hyunho Yang, research engineer for omnimodal foundation models at SK Telecom. “Seeing the passion of fellow AI developers was a real source of inspiration for me.” Community leaders share how they build with open models and tools at AI Day Seoul. The Agentic AI 10x Bootcamp Community Day brought together Pseudo Lab, Python Korea, PyTorchKR, HAERAE, Hugging Face KREW, Graph User Group, Womxn Who Code Korea, Dnol (Datayanolja) and other developer communities. Five finalists from the Hangul Day hackathon, co-hosted with Fastcampus, built agents trained on the Korean language and culture with the OpenShell runtime. The winning team, FlyGate, received an NVIDIA DGX Spark system. More than 500 developers also took part in full-day NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute workshops and NVIDIA Certification exams in Korean. On the latest episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast , Rebecca Bellan, Tim De Chant, and I discussed how Huang’s ouster went down and what it means for the larger AI economy. (At the same time, there are many who’d still like to see him return .) And we also took a moment to wonder what will happen to Nvidia’s investments in the larger AI ecosystem. Web Summit leaned heavily into Chinese founders and companies this year. The opening remarks from Web Summit co-founder Paddy Cosgrave drove the point home when he said the superstars of the future are coming from China, not California. He also gave a strong endorsement of China and open source technology when he noted that Chinese companies are building more of our shared future than anyone else. These remarks carried a different kind of weight just a few days later as the news spread throughout the conference that Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang had resigned from his leadership post after admitting to an affair with an alleged spy. The former CEO, after all, has been one of the strongest proponents for open source in the United States. And anyone who has followed the emergence of autonomous vehicle tech knows how central Nvidia is to that ecosystem. Nvidia is a major supplier of AI computing technology to the industry — although the degree of reliance varies. Some companies are using Nvidia’s automotive processors to run automated driving software, while others are using Nvidia GPUs to train autonomous driving models. And then there are the full-stack partnerships, which includes Mercedes-Benz, Zoox, and Wayve. I spoke to Leo Wang , the CFO of Chinese autonomous vehicle company Pony.ai , this week. I asked him about the challenges China’s self-driving industry faces and what he thinks will happen if the fallout from Huang’s resignation results in even stricter export controls on Nvidia chips shipped to China. items.t: Where was Nvidia’s security team?
items.d: Nvidia’s security chief quietly left in August, and now that CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down over his relationships, including one with an executive at a company suspected of funneling chips to China, a former intelligence officer says it’s the kind of leak that runs everyday conversations, which most corporate security teams are poorly equipped to catch.
items.fullText: Outsiders had little reason to notice when Nvidia’s longtime chief security officer and head of product security stepped down in August. Just two and a half months later, CEO Jensen Huang himself left the company over growing questions about his extramarital relationships — starting with an executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore data center company that U.S. investigators suspect of funneling Nvidia chips to China, then widening to reports about two separate affairs with Nvidia employees. At the time, David Reber, who spent four years as CSO and seven at Nvidia overall, said he was leaving for health reasons. “This wasn’t a pivot I had planned. But I know what needs to come first: family and health,” he wrote on LinkedIn in late August, disclosing that he’d been diagnosed with young-onset Parkinson’s more than two years ago. Reber’s replacement, Saša Zdjelar, previously spent 17 years at ExxonMobil in Houston, leaving as a senior IT manager before spending one year at Salesforce and several years at the cybersecurity company ReversingLabs. Zdjelar didn’t respond to questions Thursday about the transition or what the security team knew. Nothing public connects Reber’s or Zdjelar’s role changes to the Megaspeed matter, but it seems fair to wonder what Nvidia’s security team knew about the government’s scrutiny of Megaspeed and about Huang’s relationships, and whether anyone raised concerns. Reber didn’t respond to questions Thursday. Nvidia also has not answered our related questions. Relationships between a CEO and his employees typically fall to HR, legal and the board, not security. But security specialists say any affair — even one inside the office — can give a foreign intelligence service leverage over an exec who wants it kept quiet. Still, spotting the clues isn’t easy. items.t: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
items.d: The petition had attracted more than 115,000 signatures as of Saturday afternoon.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 1:41 PM PST · November 14, 2026 Image Credits: Li Hongbo/VCG / Getty Images Anthony Ha Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang A petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate the company’s recently ousted CEO Jensen Huang appears to have attracted more than 115,000 signatures as of Saturday afternoon. The petition website said the signers include 5,965 current Nvidia employees, 1,108 former employees, and 63,063 shareholders. Notable supporters include Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, Replit CEO Amjad Masad, Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, and Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan. The petition states that its signers are “concerned that Jensen was removed without meaningful due process” and demands that the board “bring him back while an independent investigation establishes the facts.” It also calls on the board to ensure a fair investigation and provide more information to the public. “Jensen deserves due process, not mob justice,” the petition says. Huang resigned on Thursday , four days after confessing to having an affair with a chip executive suspected by U.S. intelligence to be a Chinese spy. The former CEO has agreed to testify before Congress, while news reports have also suggested that Huang engaged in multiple extramarital affairs . Nvidia appointed CFO Colette Kress as the company’s interim CEO while it searches for a permanent replacement. Nvidia’s stock price fell sharply through the week, while Huang’s departure is also expected to leave a big gap in AI industry funding .
